mapper.sql: select row_id, customer_code, customer_name, customer_short_name, trade_type, province_id, province_name, city_id, city_name, county_id, county_name, street_id, street_name, customer_address, contact_name, contact_phone, main_business, remark, channel_type, channel_code, channel_name, customer_status, active_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, impower_type, databaseName, datasource, ext1, ext2, logo, send_flag, send_time, sender, scope, auth_user_num, sales_manager, sales_phone, create_db_state, create_db_time, create_db_by, create_db_exception, v_id, use_state, invite_code from hyzz_customer

select a.row_id, a.customer_code, a.customer_name, a.customer_short_name, a.trade_type, a.province_id, a.province_name, a.city_id, a.city_name, a.county_id, a.county_name, a.street_id, a.street_name, a.customer_address, a.contact_name, a.contact_phone, a.main_business, a.remark, a.channel_type, a.channel_code, a.channel_name, a.customer_status, a.active_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.impower_type, a.databaseName, a.datasource, a.ext1, a.ext2, a.send_flag, a.send_time, a.sender, a.v_id, a.use_state, b.play_user, b.user_name, b.nick_name, b.phonenumber, b.del_flag, b.account_type, b.password, a.customer_source, a.customer_product_type, b.valid_date, c.use_status from hyzz_customer a left join hyzz_customer_user b on a.customer_code = b.customer_code left join hyzz_customer_application c on a.customer_code = c.customer_code
mapper.select: select a.row_id, a.customer_code, a.customer_name, a.customer_short_name, a.trade_type, a.province_id, a.province_name, a.city_id, a.city_name, a.county_id, a.county_name, a.street_id, a.street_name, a.customer_address, a.contact_name, a.contact_phone, a.main_business, a.remark, a.channel_type, a.channel_code, a.channel_name, a.customer_status, a.active_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.impower_type, a.databaseName, a.datasource, a.ext1, a.ext2, a.send_flag, a.send_time, a.sender, a.v_id, a.use_state from hyzz_customer a where a.use_state =1 and a.create_db_state=2

select databaseName, datasource, customer_name as customerName, customer_short_name as customerShortName, customer_code as customerCode, cuba_id as cubaId, row_id rowId from hyzz_customer where customer_code = #{customerCode} and use_state = 1
select databaseName, datasource, customer_name as customerName, customer_short_name as customerShortName, customer_code as customerCode from hyzz_customer where cuba_id = #{cubaId} and use_state = 1

select databaseName, datasource, customer_name as customerName, customer_short_name as customerShortName, customer_code as customerCode from hyzz_customer
and customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%')

select a.user_name,a.nick_name,a.account_type ,b.customer_name,b.customer_code from hyzz_customer b,hyzz_customer_user a where a.customer_code=b.customer_code and a.user_name in
replace(#{item},' ','')

select a.user_name as userName, a.nick_name as nickName, a.account_type as accountType, b.customer_name as customerName, b.customer_code as customerCode from hyzz_customer b inner join hyzz_customer_user a on a.customer_code = b.customer_code where b.active_flag = 1 and ( a.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or a.nick_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') ) and b.customer_code = #{customerCode}
select * from hyzz_customer where channel_type='N' and industry_attribute=1
